successCriteria.description: The exported function ResourcePrefix(value string) (string, bool) exists in internal/id/resource.go and returns (prefix, true) when value matches the shape of a resource ID with one of the seven Prefix* constants, and ("", false) otherwise.

Table-driven tests in internal/id/resource_test.go cover: a valid ID for each of the seven Prefix* constants, an unknown prefix, a value one hex character too short, a value with uppercase hex characters, and the empty string — each asserting the expected (prefix, ok) tuple.
Existing tests in internal/id/resource_test.go continue to pass after the change, confirming no regression in HasResourceShape, Resource, or the existing helper functions.
make test and make lint both succeed with the new code, confirming compilation, race-free execution, and lint compliance.

constraints: ResourcePrefix must reuse HasResourceShape and the seven existing Prefix* constants for all validation logic — no new shape-checking logic, no new imports, no new dependencies.
No new files, no new dependencies, and no modifications to existing functions or call sites are permitted.
Tests must follow the project convention: table-driven, in the id_test external package, with t.Parallel() on subtests.
The build must remain compatible with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no cgo dependencies introduced).
outOfScope: Any API endpoint or handler that consumes ResourcePrefix — this phase only adds the utility function and its tests.
Changes to the ResourceID entity shape, the Prefix* constants, or the HasResourceShape validation logic.
Frontend integration or console-side usage of ResourcePrefix.

entityInvariants.invariant: A ResourceID's prefix must be one of the seven Prefix* constants (PrefixInstance, PrefixImage, PrefixKeyPair, PrefixTask, PrefixVPC, PrefixSubnet, PrefixNetworkInterface), and its hex part must be exactly 17 lowercase hex characters.
ResourcePrefix must return the exact prefix constant that matched; it must never return a modified or aliased prefix string.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — pure utility function, no authentication required.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns ("", false) on no match rather than an error value; no panics on any input.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: ResourcePrefix must iterate the same seven Prefix* constants defined in internal/id/resource.go and delegate every shape check to HasResourceShape — the validation contract must remain identical to what HasResourceShape already enforces.

Test cases must use the same valid ID format (prefix + "-" + 17 lowercase hex chars) that HasResourceShape accepts, and the same invalid inputs (too short, uppercase hex, empty string, unknown prefix) that HasResourceShape rejects.
The test file must remain in the id_test external package and follow the existing table-driven pattern with t.Parallel() subtests, matching the style of TestHasResourceShape and TestResource.

integrationPoints.target: internal/id/resource.go — append ResourcePrefix alongside existing functions without modifying HasResourceShape, Resource, or any Prefix* constant.
integrationPoints.why: The function must coexist with the existing id package API and reuse its constants and validation logic.

integrationPoints.target: internal/id/resource_test.go — append a new TestResourcePrefix function in the id_test package.
integrationPoints.why: Tests must live alongside existing tests in the same package and file, following the established table-driven convention.
